'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Good day to you, merc! Wanna become a respected member of Tarkov's fine society? Then you'll have to do some business with me, Wanna do some trading, perhaps? Or you can help me out with a few little tasks. There's always work to be found. Well, I'll do my best to find some for you, at least.}}

==Requirements==
* Must be level 15 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Reach Loyalty Level 2 with [[Ragman]]

==Rewards==
* +6,700 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 10,000 Roubles
** 10,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 11,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[BlackHawk! Commando chest harness (Desert Tan)]]
{{quote|Now that's how it's done! We're almost like best buddies now}}
